name: ai-agent-sdk-workspace
description: Private workspace orchestration for ai-agent-sdk packages

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/core build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/testkit build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/a2a build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/mcp-server build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/mcp build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/mcp-node build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/mcp-node-server build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/skill-filesystem build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/instructions-node build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/provider-http build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/protocol-anthropic-messages build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/protocol-responses build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/protocol-gemini-interactions build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/provider-anthropic build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/provider-openai build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/provider-codex build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/provider-gemini build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/auth-node build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/observability-fetch build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/observability-browser build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/observability-node build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/observability-otel build
scripts.lint: node scripts/check-package-graph.mts && node scripts/check-dependency-cruiser.mts && node scripts/check-agent-boundaries.mts && node scripts/check-runtime-boundaries.mts
scripts.check:graph: node scripts/check-package-graph.mts && node scripts/check-dependency-cruiser.mts && node scripts/check-agent-boundaries.mts
scripts.test:pack: pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' check:publint && pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' check:types && pnpm --workspace-concurrency=1 -r --filter './packages/*' test:pack
scripts.test:edge: pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/core test:pack && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/provider-http test:pack && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/mcp test:pack && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/observability-otel test:pack && pnpm test:no-follow
scripts.test:node: pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/auth-node test:pack && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/mcp-node test:pack && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/mcp-node-server test:pack && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/skill-filesystem test:pack && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/instructions-node test:pack && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/observability-node test:pack
scripts.test:recovery: vitest run tests/unit/observability.spec.ts tests/unit/observability-node.spec.ts && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/observability-browser test:pack
scripts.human:deep-research: pnpm build:cli --silent && node dist-cli/human.mjs --mode deep --scenario deep-research --no-force-tool --max-turns 12
